title: ccx never re-renders composer/footer chrome on a WIDTH change: shrink duplicates the composer block and leaves hard-wrapped remainder rules, grow leaves the rules at the old narrower width; height-only resizes are clean
repro: launch ccx fresh at 120x40, no turns
tmux resize-window to the target size
capture-pane -p and measure rule widths vs pane_width + count composer blocks
ccx: Single-resize-from-fresh controls (frames-qa2/matrix-fresh/): 120x40->60x24 composer_blocks=2, seven 60-wide rules where there should be two. 120x40->80x24 composer_blocks=2, stale 40-wide remainder rules. 120x40->100x24 composer_blocks=2, stale 20-wide remainder rules. 120x40->160x24 composer_blocks=1 but rules stay 120 wide inside a 160-wide pane (grow never widens them). 60x24->120x24 rules stay 60 wide. CONTROLS THAT PASS: 120x24->120x40 and 80x40->80x15 are both clean — height alone is never the trigger. Cumulative 15-cell sweep over widths {60,80,100,120,160} x heights {15,24,40} with a staged two-turn transcript (frames-qa2/matrix-transcript/): ccx fails 15/15 on composer_blocks=2, and 12/15 also carry stale rule widths that accumulate the whole resize history (at 160x40 the frame still holds a 60-wide rule from six resizes earlier). Returning to the launch geometry 120x40 does NOT clear it.
claude: Passes every one of the same 15 cells: composer_blocks=1, rule widths always exactly pane_width, zero overlong lines (frames-qa2/matrix-transcript/cc-*.txt). Grow control frames-qa2/matrix-fresh/cc-60x24-to-120x24.txt: rules go 60->120 and the welcome box is redrawn at 120.
suspects: the composer/footer renderer caches a width at first paint and the SIGWINCH path re-emits without clearing the previous block; contrast with the ctrl+o pager which does clear (qa2-11)
